evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01", a date with no time. A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 with {"dueDate":"2026-09-30"} changed the date (200). PATCH with {"dueDate":null} removed it (dueDate null). PATCH with only a title left the date alone. PATCH with {"dueDate":"2026-12-25"} set it again.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "14.10.2026" and "garbage" each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "nope" each returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-14. The test todos were: past (2026-10-01, not done), future (2026-12-25), today (2026-10-14), none (no date), and pastdone (2026-09-01, marked done). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the 'past' todo. The done todo, the due-today todo, the future todo and the no-date todo were all excluded.
evidence.AC5: The browser snapshot of / showed a <time> element with the due date for each todo that has one: 2026-10-01, 2026-12-25, 2026-10-14 and 2026-09-01. The todo without a date showed none.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the 'past' todo had the text 'überfällig'. The future, today, no-date and done-past todos had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. After I clicked it, the list contained only the 'past' todo with its überfällig marker.
